div.head: CHn cor 5.1
div.ab: Si quis captus fuerit, sive monetarius sive alius, cum falsa moneta, iusticia recta inde fiat.
If a moneyer or any other person has been seized with false money, the process fitted to the case shall be carried out.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 278–279 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
